notes.title: Update
notes.content:
It has been a little while so I wanted to give a little update on things.

We just got back from Maryland to our home in Indiana a couple of weeks ago. I had successful bone marrow transplant done in January at the NIH (National Institutes of Health) in Maryland. I just got the call that the UAB1 test came back, and I no longer have VEXAS. This is the best news. It is still a long road to full recovery but the is such great news. I still have to wait until July when I go back for my follow up and have a bone marrow biopsy done to see if the Blood Cancer is gone but the doctors are very confident that it is gone as well. This journey has been a roller coaster of emotions. I am so thankful for my donor who has blessed me with a second chance at life. Even through these difficult times God has blessed us in so many ways. We are very thankful.

I was not able to work on or do any updates to either Morels game while I was out in Maryland. The project files that I had access to for the games would just constantly crash. I do not know if it was an issue with the laptop I was using or an issue with the project files. 

I spent most of my time in Maryland just trying to recover from the transplant and then working on my solo game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3108130/Bigfoot_Life/]Bigfoot Life[/url]. We have also started to work on the next Morels game. Morels: Out of this World. I can't wait to share more information on this game. The goal was when I got back I was going to do an update for both Morels games based on a lot of the feedback I've seen posted in the Steam Hubs. I also released a demo of Bigfoot life and entered it in the Steam Next Fest. Well, this has ended up being a little too much all at once and I've actually started to get a little bit of GVHD (Graft Versus Host Disease). The doctors believe it could just be from stress of over doing it with the game stuff. They have suggested that I step back a little and give my body more time to heal from the transplant. I decided to pulled Bigfoot Life out of the Steam Fest as well.

I am still planning on doing the updates to the Morels games as well as give out more information on the new game. Right now though I've decided from feedback from my doctor's that it is best if I ease back into things and don't feel so rushed to do everything. Recovery from the transplant takes a long time and I have to prioritize my health. So, the updates and information on the new game are coming. They may just take a little longer than I originally was hoping.

Thank you for all of your support and understanding.

-Wes
Abrams Studios

notes.title: Wholesome Games Sale and Crystal Morel Upate Live!
notes.content:
In celebration of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]Wholesome Games Celebration[/url], we have discounted both Morels: The Hunt games to their biggest discounts yet. The Crystal Morel update is also live.

The Crystal Morel is not anything you are tasked with finding. It is something that is completely optional and just a bonus if you do find it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/75b79192d4fa3334813f68f6055d310b95691b53.jpg[/img]

-There is only one Crystal Morel in each Morels: The Hunt game.
-It is hidden in a map in the same spot all the time like the Golden Morels.
-The Crystal Morel will be displayed in your Trophy Room above the Golden Morels.
-If you find the Crystal Morel, you will unlock the very first game we ever made before the Morels: The Hunt games.
-You will be able to access this game on the Main Menu after you find the Crystal Morel.

[h2]Information about the game that is unlocked.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/9b4a52c3f49e85add2128b2039e826920fb14ea3.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] It is the first game I ever made years ago. Nothing has been changed. It is the exact game made from way back then.
[*] It is a mushroom hunting game.
[*] It uses a different pickup method explained in the instructions of the game.
[*] The graphics won't be great, it is a very small game, and the game will be a bit janky.
[*] The game is only in English.
[*] Each Morels: the Hunt game will feature the same game but a different map to play. The concept will be the same. Find all 16 morel mushrooms in the map.
[/list]

We know some of you might be interested in just checking out the game that gets unlocked and don't want to take the time to search every map in the game just to find the Crystal Morel. We have decided to add hints to where the Crystal Morel is in in each game at the link below. This link will show you which map the Crystal Morel is in each game. There are links on this page that will also show you its location on the map. You can view the page to just find out the map it is in if that is all you want to know. You will have to click on the links on the page to see the actual locations.

[h2]Crystal Morel Hints[/h2]
[url=https://www.abramsstudios.com/crystal-morel/]https://www.abramsstudios.com/crystal-morel/[/url]

Thank you for all your support!

-The Abrams Studios Team

notes.title: Health and Updates
notes.content:
This is Wes from Abrams Studios. As many of you know, our studio is made up of just three brothers. We make games about things we love and are passionate about. None of us are able to do this full-time making our resources limited. I am the lead developer, only programmer, the one who handles all support issues, manages the Steam Community Hub and Social Media. 

The reason why I wanted to mention the above is because I am dealing with some health issues that have hit me harder than expected. There will be times like this last week where I will be limited to what I can do on the game because of my health. This will eventually lead to me having to have a Bone Marrow Transplant sometime between Summer and Fall. When that happens I will mostly likely have to take a couple of months off. I felt it was important to let everyone know at least a little about the situation so there will be no surprise when that happens. I will make a post on here when that time comes so everyone knows there my be limited replies or updates during that time. Until then we will do our best to keep updating the game and I will do my best to keep up with support and the steam hub as well. There will be other times where my treatment or other things to do with my health may delay my responses but I will do my best to get back to everyone as soon as I can.

[h2]Game Update[/h2]

We just put out a small update to address the issue of lion's mane mushrooms being too hard to find. In this update there should be more lion's mane mushrooms. There may be a little less chicken of the woods mushrooms.

The Zombie Otter has also been fixed.


Thanks for all the support.

-Wes and the Abrams Studios Team

notes.title: Morels 2 - April 26th Update
notes.content:
Thank you again to everyone who has played and supported Morels 2. It means so much to us. We've been listening to your feedback and have a new build live with some updates and fixes.

[h2]Updates[/h2]

[h3]Night Vision[/h3]
We have added Night Vision back in as a camera mode option. It will be a free upgrade with the purchase of the upgraded headlamp. We have added a sign to the headlamp upgrade stand that lets you know about the Night Vision free camera mode update.

[h3]Insect Collision[/h3]
We have updated the insect collision so it does not collide and alter vehicles.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Disappearing hummingbird feeders - This should now be fixed.
[*] Golf Cart Too Tired Corrupt Save Game - There was a bug that would sometimes corrupt your save game if you were on your golf cart when the "Too Tired" message came up at the end of the day. This should be fixed now.
[*] Random Werewolf Mystery Animal - A bug was causing a werewolf to spawn in the Mountain Forest map instead of a normal wolf. This should be fixed now and you should not be able to see the Werewolf in this game anymore.
[*] Animals and mushrooms underwater in the Mountain Forest Map. - This should hopefully be fixed now and you should not see many if any animals or mushrooms pinned underwater in this map.
[*] Hare, this animal is dead bug - There was a bug that caused the hare to not play the dead animation when it would be attacked by a coyote or other predators. A message would say that the animal was dead but it clearly looked alive. This was due to it not playing the correct animations. This should be fixed now.
[*] Other minor fixes like some floating foliage or meshes.
[/list]

We will keep listening to your feedback and putting out updates. Thank you again for all the support.

-The Abrams Studios Team

notes.title: Morels: The Hunt 2 - April 21st Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has played and supported the game. We hope everyone has enjoyed playing it. It has been a great launch. We have such a great community. If you have enjoyed playing the game, maybe consider leaving a review. They are really helpful.

[h2]Fatal Error Fix[/h2]

We have done a bunch of optimizations to the game that should hopefully fix the Fatal Error Crash that sometimes happens. If you are still experiencing this crash there are a few things you can try.

[list]
[*] Make sure graphic drivers are up to date.
[*] Try turning off Discord before launching the game.
[*] Verify your game files. [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB]https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB[/url]
[*] Try turning off the Squirrel Pong Loading Screen in Settings.
[*] If you experience the crash when loading Birch Forest for the first time try loading the game again and see if it goes through without the crash the second time.
[*] Start a new game in Exploration mode and go to another map like meadow lands first. Then go to Birch Forest and see if the game crashes. If it does not, try to load and play or main game again.
[/list]

We are still working to figure out the cause of the crash. It does not appear to happen to that many people or that often but we really want to get it fixed completely. Until we know for sure it is fixed completely, the above options may fix it for you if you are experiencing it.

[h2]Other Fixes.[/h2]

There were some other minor fixes as well that we have fixed in this build. Like some errors in text in for  the Mystery Animals. We plan on putting out another update soon with some more fixes that have been listed in the bugs and suggestions forum. For this update we really wanted to focus on the Fatal Error Crash issue.

Thank you again for all of your support.

-The Abrams Studios Team

We wanted to share some development updates for Morels 2.

[h3][b]These are the 7 new maps.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/95e01a89cf305d4d6820147de74b097c3880b9ca.png[/img]

[h3][b]These are the new items available for purchase in the shop.[/b][/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/699e3812136da1938246d1c51887f417059c2a25.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/8a41a913b0da241467ad5029913cfe35f90bb672.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/f815a002bd2da98bc44cc2bfd85001f6669c0685.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/d3bc257d5f126906208bd8da891ec47bfff11e54.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/0aa97f999b3d4eb25cc433d54cdf56f27b6384c5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/8cb6d75eda66d12faa59e1cc43e49837f157e4b8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/aad931f03a8d9fb8bbed988135913d9d6591bceb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/a17e164722a00c8b8322187001a9ac491539ba3c.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/544dc518cc8583c2b264201a39deb8b8faea7c0f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/e7f8fad372cd3be8cec836c93252ec1d889aa165.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/eef84aebef7f1faa994846adcef7df5d4f3b2767.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/d03beed80b7635fdf7bb3cabb146776faf8faa4f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/fc491ea10c1f6d18bf2628423c715997ca1e9b01.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/f6281c6195def3d49bc6663e0c2bfd2f3fd563f4.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/931d74e7880e5981f5ee6c7d76d806a0c68ee91b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/bd2c9f1dc1452e069ea583454454915753d49f30.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Hummingbird feeder[/h3] - Attracts hummingbirds. This item can be placed anywhere in any map. It will stay there forever unless you pick it up and bring it back to your inventory. There is no quantity limit on this item.

[h3]Deer Stand[/h3] - Animals will not fear or run away from you while on this stand. This item can be placed anywhere in any map. You can not bring it back into your inventory once you place it down. It will remain forever wherever you place it down at. There is no quantity limit on this item.

[h3]Compass[/h3] - Adds a compass to your UI.

[h3]Headlamp Light Upgrade[/h3] - Will make your headlamp much brighter and shine further.

[h3]Sunglasses[/h3] - Will lighten dark shaded areas and darken the brightness of the sun.

[h3]Scuba Tank[/h3] - Will allow you to stay underwater for an unlimited amount of time. It will be needed to hunt in the Ocean Islands map.

[h3]Animal Minimap Detection[/h3] - Shows you an animal location on your minimap.

[h3]Mushroom Minimap Detection[/h3] - Shows you a location mushrooms have been found on your minimap.

[h3][b]Photo Tasks[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/5512e575e2b3b3672a67240cb347c816541cfad7.png[/img]

- 18 mushrooms besides morels to collect
- 60 Animals to photograph
- 15 Sea Animals to photograph
- 17 Insects to photograph
- 28 Objects to photograph
- 7 New mystery animals

[h3][b]Optional Daily Bonus Tasks[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749463/82e882c04618201953eb5c84c17af1b44ce65c13.png[/img]


These are just some of the new updates for the game. We look forward to sharing more soon.

Thank you for all the support!

- The Abrams Studios Team
